state.purpose: Synthetic NPC architecture probes, not an actual railway operational situation.

observations: At a public junction, signs point to passage A and passage B.
Neither passage has been inspected from here; both turn out of view.
There is no trustworthy destination, accessibility or hazard information for either passage.
A staffed information point can be contacted without entering either passage.
route_actor.goal: Choose an informed next step without declaring an unobserved passage suitable.

shared_resource.cart: One transport cart stands unclaimed in the public work area.
shared_resource.worker_a: Needs to move bulky cleaning supplies; moving them without the cart is impractical. May submit a cart request.
shared_resource.worker_b: Needs to move bulky replenishment supplies; moving them without the cart is impractical. May submit a cart request.
shared_resource.observations: Both workers see the same unclaimed cart. No resource coordinator has yet accepted a reservation. Their current waiting positions are safe.
shared_resource.execution_contract: A request is only a candidate, not a reservation or a completed movement. This request does not execute any action.

route_with_abstention.instructions: For the route_actor, choose the next action using only its observed information. Do not invent passage conditions.

criteria.contact_information: Remain in the observed public junction and ask the staffed information point about the passages before choosing one.
criteria.commit_passage_a: Commit to passage A as the suitable route without verifying its conditions.
criteria.commit_passage_b: Commit to passage B as the suitable route without verifying its conditions.

route_without_abstention.instructions: For the same route_actor, choose its next action using only its observed information. Do not invent passage conditions. The API requires one of the supplied options; neither is established as suitable by the state.
